def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in g]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in comp: continue
                    comp.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==c and (x,y) not in comp: stack.append((x,y))
                out.append((c,frozenset(comp)))
    return out

def solve(I,O=None):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

    cells=sorted(big[1])
    r0=min(a for a,_ in cells); c0=min(b for _,b in cells)
    h=max(a for a,_ in cells)-r0+1; w=max(b for _,b in cells)-c0+1
    P={(a-r0,b-c0) for a,b in cells}
    Hh,Ww=len(I),len(I[0])

    # big shape drawn (it's unchanged)

    # sort markers: process colors / components in reading order

    marks.sort()
    O_=[[bg]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    for a,b in cells: O_[a][b]=big[0]
    res=[]
    for i0,j0,mk in marks:
        best=None
        for (a,b) in sorted(P):
            dr,dc=i0-a,j0-b
            st=frozenset((x+dr,y+dc) for x,y in P)

from collections import Counter
def comps(I,bg=None):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    if bg is None: bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if I[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                col=I[i][j]; q=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and I[x][y]==col:
                            seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
                out.append((col,cells))
    return bg,out
